name: ai-illustrator-workflow
description: Reconstruct scientific, commercial, technical, and editorial references as editable native Adobe Illustrator artwork.

interface.shortDescription: 把各类参考图重构为可编辑的原生 Illustrator 文件
interface.longDescription: A reference-first Illustrator workflow for scientific figures, commercial graphics, technical diagrams, infographics, editorial artwork, icons, and other layered vector reconstruction tasks.
defaultPrompt: 把这张参考图重构为可编辑的 Illustrator 原生对象。
先生成五张候选构图，选定后再进入 Illustrator 重构。
按底图逐区校准并检查文字、线条、颜色和渐变。
